name: argot-site
description: Documentation and learning site for Argot

scripts.dev: ARGOT_API_OPTIONAL=1 npm run generate:api && ARGOT_BUILD=docs ARGOT_API_OPTIONAL=1 vitepress dev
scripts.dev:root: ARGOT_API_OPTIONAL=1 npm run generate:api && ARGOT_BUILD=root ARGOT_API_OPTIONAL=1 vitepress dev
scripts.build:root: npm run generate:api && ARGOT_BUILD=root vitepress build
scripts.build:docs: npm run generate:api && ARGOT_BUILD=docs vitepress build
